item.title: Southfield Capital Partners With The Perfect Franchise To Support Growth And Expand Advisory Platform
item.description: Southfield Capital has entered into a strategic partnership with The Perfect Franchise (TPF), a franchise advisory and consulting firm, as the private equity investor looks to deepen its exposure to franchising-related business services and back organizations that support franchise ecosystem expansion. item.title: Pelthos Therapeutics: Up To $50 Million Venture Loan Facility Secured From Horizon Technology Finance
item.description: Horizon Technology Finance Corporation, a venture lending firm focused on secured loans to venture- and private equity-backed companies, said it has provided a venture loan facility of up to $50 million to Pelthos Therapeutics, a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company focused on commercial-stage dermatology products. item.title: I Squared Capital Launches ANZA Power With $300 Million Commitment
item.description: I Squared Capital has launched ANZA Power, a next-generation independent power producer established to deliver reliable and sustainable energy solutions across Australia and New Zealand. Backed by a USD $300 million commitment from I Squared’s ISQ Growth Markets Infrastructure Fund II, the new platform is designed to provide clean, dispatchable power for commercial and industrial customers while supporting grid resilience and long-term reliability. item.title: PolyML Announces Strategic Investment From Martinrea International
item.description: PolyML announced it has secured a strategic minority investment from Martinrea International Inc., a global automotive supplier, alongside a multi-year services and collaboration agreement to deploy PolyML’s machine-learning technology across automotive manufacturing operations. item.title: EverGen Infrastructure Announces Closing of New FCC Credit Facility
item.description: EverGen Infrastructure announced it has completed a package of refinancing transactions that includes a new $13 million asset-level credit facility with Farm Credit Canada (FCC) at its wholly owned subsidiary Fraser Valley Biogas Ltd. (FVB), repayment of most of its corporate-level debt, and the closing of a second tranche of a previously announced non-brokered private placement for approximately $1.9 million in gross proceeds. item.title: Northwestern And Stanford Researchers Create Artificial Metabolism That Turns Waste CO2 Into Useful Chemicals
item.description: Northwestern University and Stanford University researchers have engineered a fully synthetic metabolic system that converts a simple liquid molecule derived from carbon dioxide into a core building block of life, potentially opening a new route to convert captured CO2 into commercially valuable chemicals. item.title: Worthington Steel To Acquire Kloeckner In $2.4 Billion Cash Deal
item.description: Worthington Steel plans to acquire Germany-listed Kloeckner & Co. in a cash tender offer that would create a more diversified, larger-scale metals processing platform and make Worthington Steel the No. 2 steel service center company in North America by revenue. item.title: Mission Wealth Names 8 New Partners In 2026 Leadership Class
item.description: Mission Wealth, a registered investment advisory firm, said it has elevated eight leaders to its 2026 Partner Class, bringing the firm’s total partner group to 66. The firm said partners now represent roughly one-third of its personnel, positioning the move as a marker of continued growth and an emphasis on internal ownership and leadership continuity. item.title: IBM Launches Sovereign Core Software To Help Organizations Run AI Workloads Under Local Control And Compliance
item.description: IBM has introduced IBM Sovereign Core, a new software offering designed to help enterprises, governments, and service providers build and operate “AI-ready” sovereign environments where customers retain direct operational control, keep identity and encryption controls within jurisdictional boundaries, and generate auditable evidence for ongoing compliance.
